description: Creates one of: a case file, a subfolder, saved references (articles, statutes, decisions, CADA opinions, CNIL deliberations, doctrine), an AI note, a skill proposal (inactive until the user activates it). Never changes existing content. Fields marked "kind: …" apply to that kind only. Requires a JusticeLibre account (OAuth sign-in); without one, the tool says so.

case_file_id.description: Case file "d_…"; not for case_file; optional for general skill_proposal.

family.description: case_file: jud, adm, ce, eu or "".

item_id.description: note: saved reference "e_…" of this case file; omit for a general note.

kind.description: case_file (requires title; permission creer_dossiers), subfolder (case_file_id, name; ranger), reference (case_file_id, references; references), note (case_file_id, text, assistant; notes_ia), skill_proposal (name, text, scope; skills).

pinned.description: note: true = follows its text into all case files (needs item_id).

references.description: reference: 1-20, checked against the database; all or nothing.

as_of.description: article, text: date of the facts YYYY-MM-DD; that version is frozen (default: today).

code.description: article: code abbreviation (CPC, CC, CRPA…) or LEGITEXT….

id.description: decision: id of /decision/<source>/<id> from search (not the case number); cada_opinion: "20230001"; cnil: "CNILTEXT…"; doctrine: fund-prefixed, "ddd:25038", "ariane_crp:4960", "bofip:…", "ctn:…".

reference_type.description: article (code+num), text (legitext), decision (source+id), cada_opinion (id), cnil (id), doctrine (id).

source.description: decision: dila (judicial), admin (TA/CAA), ariane (CE), cedh, cjue, kali.

subfolder_id.description: Subfolder "c_…"; "" = default "À ranger" area. Overrides the top-level one.

replaces.description: skill_proposal: skill "s_…"/"p_…" to replace once activated.

subfolder_id.description: reference: Subfolder "c_…"; "" = default "À ranger" area. Default for all references.

text.description: note: text; skill_proposal: the working method, written as instructions.

name: create_account_item
